study: Gate 2 Task D: thin-shell validity screen (T00)
reading: bulk-ion Larmor radii at the surface field (median about 0.4 m, at most 7.5 % of the stopping radius) are small: the flux-excluding fluid picture holds in the bulk; fast products are marginal (14.7 MeV protons up to 11 % of R where the field is weak) and kinetic effects there are a PIC-class question

the shell is thick against the G1 kinks: a 10-30 % velocity spread gives 5-15 m at the 48 m median stopping radius, against 0.5-2 m kinks. A shell that thick cannot reflect specularly off them, so the ledger regularised on the shell scale (2-8 m smoothing: eta_T 0.80-0.82) is the meaningful thin-shell value and the fine-grid 0.67 is an artefact of an infinitely thin shell; neither is a plasma result
outside the model: lateral flow toward field zeros (funnelling), Rayleigh-Taylor at the decelerating surface, the shell velocity spread itself and detachment (MHD: D-21)
magnetic Reynolds numbers are large (5e6 or more) for any electron temperature above a few eV: frozen-in flux is not the weak point
